text: What if every wheel on Earth turned square for five seconds? Bad news. You're doing seventy.
One and a half billion cars. Bang. Bang. Bang. Your spine is now a drum solo.
Your office chair stops dead. You don't. Shopping carts go square too. Nobody notices.
Every train hammers its own tracks. Sparks for miles. Still delayed.
A jumbo jet lands on square wheels. It hops like a furious kangaroo.
Every gear on Earth jams. The Ferris wheel is now a giant window frame. With you in it.
Wheels are back. Everything rolls. Everyone's alive. Nobody can sit down for a week.
Worst part? Square wheels actually work. You just need a road of curved bumps. A math professor built one.
What should turn square next? Comments. Or I pick something worse.
